entities.summary: Lya Imber was a Ukrainian-born Venezuelan pediatrician. She was a prominent pediatrician vice president of UNICEF, and the first woman in Venezuela to earn the degree of Doctor of Medical Sciences, as well as the first female member of the board of the Medical School of the Federal District.
